collection.title: Collection

grouping.hint: Tick columns to group rows by them. The top ticked column is the outermost group; use the arrows to change the nesting.
grouping.collapseAllTooltip: Collapse every group to its header

savedViews.tooltip: Saved views: switch, save or manage this page's layout
savedViews.builtInHint: Name A→Z, 100 per page, every column
savedViews.confirmDelete: Delete the view "{{name}}"? Anyone using it as their default goes back to the next default.

save.title: Save as new view
save.allGamesOnly: Only when All Games is selected
save.makeEveryoneDefault: Make it the default for everyone

copy.title: Copy "{{name}}" to other locations
copy.intro: The view is copied to each ticked location. A view with the same name there is replaced.
copy.toggleGroup: Tick or untick the whole group
copy.makeMyDefault: Use it as my default on those locations
copy.makeEveryoneDefault: Make it the default for everyone on those locations

collection.confirmDelete_one: Delete {{count}} card? This cannot be undone.
collection.confirmDelete_other: Delete {{count}} cards? This cannot be undone.

status.pickedTooltip: Listed for sale and picked into the for-sale location. Unlist it from Sales ▸ Listings to change.
status.listedTooltip: Already listed for sale. Unlist it from Sales ▸ Listings to change.

bulkList.description: Each card is listed as a whole lot at its current market price. Adjust individual prices afterwards on Sales ▸ Listings.
bulkList.alreadyListed_one: {{count}} selected card is already listed for sale and will be skipped.
bulkList.alreadyListed_other: {{count}} selected cards are already listed for sale and will be skipped.

decklist.title: Check a decklist
decklist.description: Paste a Moxfield/Archidekt URL or a decklist to see which cards you own, where to pull them from, and what's missing.
decklist.noneOwned: None of these cards are in your collection.
decklist.noneMissing: Nothing missing: you own every card in this deck.
decklist.moveNeedsAll_one: You're missing {{count}} card. Move to a deck box once you own the whole deck.
decklist.moveNeedsAll_other: You're missing {{count}} cards. Move to a deck box once you own the whole deck.
decklist.moveNoPermission: You don't have permission to move cards.
decklist.listedWarning_one: {{count}} copy is listed for sale. Moving it to a deck box leaves the listing active.
decklist.listedWarning_other: {{count}} copies are listed for sale. Moving them to a deck box leaves the listings active.
decklist.fromOtherDeckBoxes: Some copies will come out of other deck boxes: {{names}}.
